data.name: Yuvin
data.gender_notes: Yuvin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is young, new, and fresh. Indicates a joyful and vibrant personality, often associated with love and relationships. The name Yuvin carries the meaning “Youthful, young one” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Yuvin usually hope their child will grow to embody youthful, young one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that resonates with the energy of new beginnings, growth, and transformation. It is believed to bring happiness, positivity, and prosperity in one's life.
data.etymology: Yuvin belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Youthful, young one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yuvin total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
